title: Dst Index (Real-time / Quick-look, 1-hour)
description: Dst index (hourly): a measure of the axially symmetric ring current disturbance field, derived from H-component variations at four low-latitude observatories. Provided by WDC for Geomagnetism, Kyoto. Real-time (quick-look) version. Updated hourly with the latest provisional estimate; values are preliminary and will be superseded by Provisional and Final versions. Values are hourly means; timestamps are bin centers (timeStampLocation=center, HH:29:30).
datasetCitation: World Data Center for Geomagnetism, Kyoto, M. Nose, T. Iyemori, M. Sugiura, T. Kamei, A. Matsuoka, S. Imajo, and T. Kotani (2015), Geomagnetic Dst index, doi:10.17593/14515-74000

parameters.name: versionCode
parameters.label: Version Code
parameters.description: Processing status code Mm (M: 0=real-time,1=provisional,2=final; m=minor, the recalculation generation within the same major: 0=first conversion, 1 and above=reconverted after the source changed).
